newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - More bids rolled to December.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - More bids rolled to December.

text.p: More High Plains grain dealers said Tuesday that they had rolled their basis bids for hard red winter wheat to the KCBT December contract from the KCBT September contract.
Otherwise, basis bids weakened as demand for U.S. wheat remained slack.
"We can't even give the stuff away," one central Kansas dealer said.
Dealers said Monday's light rally in wheat futures failed to shake much wheat from the farmers' grip.
"We bought a little more so than I had seen on any given day last week," said a dealer in south central Kansas.
But Oklahoma dealers said there had been no discernible increase in movement on Monday.
Basis values are quoted against KCBT wheat, cash dollars/bu.
Dodge City 25 und Dec 22 und Sep 4.6050
Kansas City 12 ovr Sep 12 ovr Sep 4.9775
Fort Worth 11 ovr Dec 13 ovr Sep 4.9650
